el.¿Qué propuestas hay para retiros?: What offerings are available for retreats?
el.Tres: una clase de Hatha Yoga de 1 h 15: Three: a 1 h 15 min Hatha Yoga class, a 2 h 30 min workshop on breathwork, pranayamas and mantras, and "Baila tu respiración," which runs 1 h 15 min.
el.Para organizadores de retiros, hoteles,: For organizers of retreats, hotels, country houses and teams who create wellness experiences and want to add a guided Yoga offering.
el.¿Se puede adaptar al grupo?: Can it be adapted to the group?
el.Sí. Cada propuesta se arma según el grup: Yes. Each offering is shaped around the group, the venue and the time available. You can combine more than one in a single retreat.
el.Depende del formato, la duración y el lu: It depends on the format, the duration and the location. A quote is prepared for each retreat: write to us and we'll work it out together.
el.Son presenciales, en el lugar donde suce: They are in person, wherever your retreat is held. Piku travels as needed.
el.Contame la temática, el lugar y las fech: Tell me the theme, the location and the dates, and I'll prepare a proposal tailored to your group.
